text:
Olivia: Overnight handoff — onboarding atlas-13b-ops. Nightly eval flagged a factuality regression on ops_smoke_v1 (delta F1 -6%). Quick runbook below.

nightly-bot: ALERT: eval/regressions detected (model=atlas-13b-ops, suite=ops_smoke_v1, metric=factual_F1, delta=-6.2%). Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/19823 :rotating_light:

Sam: I'll grab the run locally, what's the exact smoke promptset?

Olivia: use `eval/ops_smoke_v1` — it's checked into `datasets/ops_smoke_v1.csv`. Also compare against `gold/ops_smoke_v1.gold` and run `scripts/run_smoke.sh --model atlas-13b-ops --batch 1`.

Devon: KV cache regen in this variant? We had a recent cache patch (PR 8288). Could that affect prefix answers?

Olivia: PR 8288 is only on serving path, not model weights. Might impact short-context retrieval. Worth toggling `--kv-warmup false` to reproduce.

Sam: Running now. Command:
```bash
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --model atlas-13b-ops --promptset eval/ops_smoke_v1 --batch 1 --kv-warmup false
```

Kevin: Noted regressions. I put up a tiny fix for tokenizer edge cases (PR 8342). Can someone eyeball the diff? cc @Olivia @Devon

Eva: I can review later today, probably by 11:30 PT.

Devon: Reproduced locally with kv-warmup false, same failure on answer id `ops_042`. Pasting snippet: "expected: 'X corp', got: 'Y corp'" — looks like tokenization split on apostrophe.

Olivia: thanks. If PR 8342 fixes tokenizer join, we can rerun nightly. Kevin if you want me to merge after your approval, say so.

Kevin: I'll push a smaller test to the PR to assert apostrophe behavior, then ping for merge. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Smoke run results: 12/100 failures, 9 matching nightly. Attached brief log: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/19823/smoke-log.txt

Olivia: Plan: Kevin lands 8342, Dev runs full ops_smoke_v1, Sam will re-run with `--kv-warmup true/false` matrix, Eva will do code review + LGTM. If green, I will schedule a rolling restart on dedicated pool tomorrow AM. No other blockers. :thumbsup:

nightly-bot: Next scheduled full eval in 4h.

Olivia: thanks team — drop updates here as you have them.
